release_notes:
ReadySetPDF 4.0.9

Large files load faster. Files are read and previewed in the background while a working spinner shows progress.

Header buttons are soft and rounded, and they adapt to smaller screens.

Assets Manager page editing: expand a multi-page PDF with the arrow, then use the Page controls section to Rotate, Resize, Blank, or Delete a single page. Edits go to a working copy, so the loaded file is untouched.

A Details button next to Assets shows page count, size, resolution, and whether a customer PDF needs a password. Locked files show (locked) in Assets Manager.

Unlock moved from a tab to a header popup.

Color tab image adjustment sliders with live preview and a Reset button.

Preflight criteria are regrouped, with tooltips on each check.

Booklet padding is fixed for page counts that are not divisible by 4.

The Join/Split arranger writes its pages into Assets.
